definitions.gloss: above, more than or equal to
definitions.explanation: Indicates a number/amount that is equal to or greater than the specified value.
Used to conclude a list, statement, or presentation.
Used with verbs to mean 'since/now that (something is the case).'

examples.japanese: {二十歳|はたち}{以上|いじょう}の{方|かた}のみ{入場|にゅうじょう}できます。
examples.english: Only those 20 and older may enter.

examples.japanese: {予想|よそう}{以上|いじょう}に{難|むずか}しかった。
examples.english: It was more difficult than expected.

examples.japanese: {約束|やくそく}した{以上|いじょう}、{守|まも}らなければならない。
examples.english: Since I promised, I must keep it.

examples.japanese: {三千円|さんぜんえん}{以上|いじょう}お{買|か}い{上|あ}げで{送料|そうりょう}{無料|むりょう}です。
examples.english: Free shipping for purchases of 3000 yen or more.

examples.japanese: {百人|ひゃくにん}{以上|いじょう}{集|あつ}まった。
{期待|きたい}{以上|いじょう}の{結果|けっか}だった。
それ{以上|いじょう}は{言|い}えない。
examples.english: I can't say more than that.

examples.japanese: {報告|ほうこく}は{以上|いじょう}です。
{以上|いじょう}で{終|お}わります。
{説明|せつめい}は{以上|いじょう}です。
{引|ひ}き{受|う}けた{以上|いじょう}、{最後|さいご}までやる。
examples.english: Since I took it on, I'll see it through.

examples.japanese: {言|い}った{以上|いじょう}は{責任|せきにん}がある。
examples.english: Now that I've said it, I have responsibility.

examples.japanese: {始|はじ}めた{以上|いじょう}、{途中|とちゅう}でやめられない。
examples.english: Since I've started, I can't quit midway.

examples.japanese: ここにいる{以上|いじょう}、{協力|きょうりょく}する。
examples.english: As long as I'm here, I'll cooperate.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}の{発表|はっぴょう}は{以上|いじょう}です。ご{質問|しつもん}があればどうぞ。
examples.english: That concludes today's presentation. If you have any questions, please go ahead.

notes:
{以上|いじょう} means 'above,' 'more than,' or 'that's all.'

IMPORTANT: In Japanese, {以上|いじょう} INCLUDES the stated number:
- {十|じゅう}{以上|いじょう} = 10 or more (includes 10)
- This differs from English 'more than' which excludes the number

Contrast with 〜を{超|こ}える:
- {十|じゅう}を{超|こ}える = more than 10 (excludes 10)

Antonym: {以下|いか} (below, less than or equal to)

Grammar pattern:
- Verb (past) + {以上|いじょう}: since ~, now that ~

Common usages:
- {以上|いじょう}です: That's all (formal conclusion)
- {予想|よそう}/{期待|きたい}/{想像|そうぞう}{以上|いじょう}: more than expected
